id: ivar_oncoplot_matrix
name: Mutation matrix
mode: variants/matrix
description: >-
  Sample by gene mutation matrix derived from the long variant table, one row
  per observed sample/gene/effect combination.
find: { filename: "variants_long_table.csv" } # same raw file as the long table
recipe: nf-core/viralrecon/oncoplot_canonical.py
fixture: oncoplot_matrix.tsv
renders_as:
  - { id: mutation_matrix, component: advanced_viz, kind: oncoplot, roles: {sample_id: sample_id, gene: gene, mutation_type: mutation_type} }
  # Both breakdown columns are required by the recipe schema, so the strips
  # cannot fall back to an empty bar on a run that omits an optional column.
  - { component: card, column: sample_id, aggregation: nunique, secondary_layout: top_n, breakdown_col: gene, top_n_count: 3 }
  - { component: card, column: gene, aggregation: nunique, secondary_layout: top_n, breakdown_col: mutation_type, top_n_count: 3 }
  - { component: table }

renders_as:
  # wide per-rank columns (Kingdom/Phylum) → sunburst fits; stacked_taxonomy
  # needs a single long-format rank column this table lacks.

  # No complex_heatmap here: this table is long (one row per sample × taxon) and
  # the server's heatmap reads a wide matrix off `index_column` with no pivot
  # step, so it can only ever plot the single `rel_abundance` column. The
  # clustered heatmap is offered by `qiime2_clustered_heatmap`, which binds the
  # canonical taxon × sample matrix the same reshape produces.

id: qiime2_tree_metadata
name: ASV taxonomy table
mode: taxonomy/classify
description: >-
  Per-ASV classification: the assigned taxon, its rank columns and the

  as the taxonomy assignment table.

fixture: tree_metadata.tsv
renders_as:
  # `uniqueness` needs no second column, so it survives a run whose taxonomy
  # table carries no rank columns (they are optional in the recipe schema).
  - { component: card, column: taxon, aggregation: nunique, secondary_layout: uniqueness }
  - { component: card, column: confidence, aggregation: average, aggregations: [box_plot_stats], secondary_layout: box_plot }
  - { component: table }
